name: pi-ask-question
adaptations: Select dialog-backed question logic; omit keyboard UI, terminal renderers and optional grill-me command/state/hooks.
Narrow factory API to registerTool; construct registrations with the public SDK types and runtime, without discovery or deep imports.
Replace AFK/best-judgement guidance with an explicit statement that no answer or approval was given.
Bound questions to 8, options to 32, labels to 1024, prompts to 8192 and IDs to 200 characters.
Check cancellation again after dialog replies; retain the upstream five-minute timer and its finally cleanup.
Use checked array assertions, a non-shadowing local binding and repository formatting; retain normalized answers in native tool-result history only.
activation: Production ACP requires form elicitation and host-owned mollyQuestionUI version 1 with run/epoch-bound dismissal.
